description: Claude Code-like CLI Experience for Dana Coding Agent - Rich terminal UI using the StarAgent notifier system with spinners, tool cards, streaming output, and collapsible results

userStories.title: Create RenderState dataclass for CLI state management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dataclass to track the current render state including phase, agent info, tool results, and expand/collapse state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/__init__.py
Create dana_agent/dana/cli/state.py with RenderState dataclass
RenderState has fields: current_phase (str), current_agent_id (str), current_model (str), current_turn (int), max_turns (int)
RenderState has fields: current_turn_results (list), historical_results (list), expanded_indices (set), selected_index (int)
RenderState has fields: todo_items (list)
Create tests/cli/__init__.py and tests/cli/test_state.py
Tests verify default values and field types
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create RichCLIRenderer skeleton implementing Notifiable
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core RichCLIRenderer class that implements the Notifiable protocol and routes broadcast messages to handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/rich_cli_renderer.py
RichCLIRenderer implements Notifiable protocol from dana/common/protocols/notifiable.py
Constructor accepts optional Console instance and config options: verbose, show_tool_calls, show_reasoning, max_output_lines
notify() method extracts broadcast keys: trace_percepts, trace_thoughts, trace_outputs, trace_learning, workflow_progress, skill_progress
notify() routes to stub handlers: _handle_see(), _handle_think(), _handle_act(), _handle_reflect(), _handle_workflow(), _handle_skill()
Create tests/cli/test_rich_cli_renderer.py with tests for message routing
Tests verify each broadcast type routes to correct handler
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement spinner component with phase-based text
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a spinner with a description of the current activity so I know the agent is working.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/__init__.py
Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/spinner.py with SpinnerComponent class
SpinnerComponent wraps rich.spinner.Spinner with configurable style (default: dots)
SpinnerComponent.update_phase(phase, context) updates text based on phase: SEE='Processing...', THINK='Thinking...', ACT='Executing {tools}...'
SpinnerComponent.start() and stop() methods control animation
Multiple tool names shown comma-separated in ACT phase
Create tests/cli/test_spinner.py
Tests verify text updates for each STAR phase
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate spinner into RichCLIRenderer handlers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to update the spinner based on STAR phase broadcasts.
acceptanceCriteria: _handle_see() updates spinner to SEE phase with perception count from trace_percepts
_handle_think() updates spinner to THINK phase, extracts tool_calls for intent display
_handle_act() updates spinner to ACT phase with tool names from trace_outputs
Spinner starts on first broadcast, stops when done=True in trace_thoughts
RichCLIRenderer uses rich.live.Live context for flicker-free updates
Tests verify spinner phase transitions through full STAR loop
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement tool card component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see formatted cards showing which tools are being invoked with their parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/tool_card.py with ToolCardComponent class
ToolCardComponent.render(tool_call) returns rich.panel.Panel
Panel header shows icon + tool name based on type: bash=wrench, file-io=folder, search=magnifier, task=robot
Panel body shows key parameters: bash shows command (truncated >100 chars), file-io shows path, search shows pattern+path, task shows agent_id+prompt[:50]
Create tests/cli/test_tool_card.py
Tests verify card rendering for bash, file-io, search, and task tool types
Tests verify parameter truncation works correctly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate tool cards into RichCLIRenderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to display tool cards when tools are invoked.
acceptanceCriteria: _handle_think() extracts tool_calls and renders ToolCardComponent for each
Tool cards appear in chronological order within a turn
Cards render before spinner during ACT phase
Tests verify tool cards render during THINK phase with correct content
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement streaming text display component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the agent's response stream in real-time as chunks arrive.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/stream_display.py with StreamDisplayComponent class
StreamDisplayComponent.append_chunk(text) adds text to buffer and triggers re-render
StreamDisplayComponent.render() returns rich.text.Text with markdown preserved
Long responses (>50 lines) show last 20 lines with '[N lines above]' indicator
StreamDisplayComponent.clear() resets buffer for new response
Create tests/cli/test_stream_display.py
Tests verify chunk accumulation and line limiting
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate streaming display into RichCLIRenderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to stream LLM responses during THINK phase.
acceptanceCriteria: _handle_think() extracts response text and streams to StreamDisplayComponent
Streaming text appears below spinner (both visible simultaneously)
StreamDisplayComponent clears when new STAR loop begins (new user message)
Tests verify streaming integrates with Live context without flicker
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement status line component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a persistent status line showing the current agent and model.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/status_line.py with StatusLineComponent class
StatusLineComponent.update(agent_id, model, turn, max_turns) updates display
StatusLineComponent.render() returns formatted string: 'agent_id | model | turn N/M'
Turn info only shown if turn > 0
Create tests/cli/test_status_line.py
Tests verify status line format for various states
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate status line into RichCLIRenderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to display and update the status line.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer maintains StatusLineComponent instance
Status line updates from RenderState on each broadcast
Status line displayed at bottom of terminal output
When subagent is invoked (detected via agent_id change), status updates to show subagent
When subagent completes, status returns to parent agent
Tests verify status line updates during agent transitions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement progress tracker component for todo items
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator for multi-step tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/progress_tracker.py with ProgressTrackerComponent class
ProgressTrackerComponent.update_todos(todo_items) updates internal list
ProgressTrackerComponent.render() returns rich.progress.Progress or rich.table.Table showing: completed (checkmark), in_progress (spinner), pending (circle)
Progress bar shows '[N/M] Current task description'
Returns None if no todo items exist (no display)
Create tests/cli/test_progress_tracker.py
Tests verify progress calculation and status icons
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate progress tracker into RichCLIRenderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to display todo progress from broadcasts.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer extracts todo_list from trace_thoughts broadcasts
ProgressTrackerComponent updates when todo_list changes
Progress display appears above status line when todos exist
Progress updates in real-time as tasks complete
Tests verify progress integration with broadcast flow
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement result panel component with collapse/expand
userStories.description: As a user, I want tool results to be collapsible, with recent results interactive and historical results static.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dana_agent/dana/cli/components/result_panel.py with ResultPanelComponent class
ResultPanelComponent stores tool_name, output, exit_code, line_count, is_recent flag
ResultPanelComponent.render(expanded) returns rich.panel.Panel - collapsed shows summary, expanded shows full output
Collapsed summary format: 'tool_name -> exit code N, M lines'
Default expand state: expanded if <10 lines, collapsed if >=10 lines
Visual distinction: recent panels have border, historical panels are dimmed/no border
Create tests/cli/test_result_panel.py
Tests verify collapsed vs expanded rendering and visual distinction
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement keyboard navigation for result panels
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate and toggle recent results with keyboard.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer tracks selected_index and expanded_indices in RenderState
Up/Down arrow keys change selected_index among current_turn_results
Enter or Space toggles expand/collapse for selected result
Selected result has visual highlight (different border color or marker)
Historical results are not selectable (keyboard skips them)
Create tests for keyboard state management
Tests verify selection and toggle logic
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate result panels into RichCLIRenderer with recent/historical transition
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to manage result panels and transition them from recent to historical.
acceptanceCriteria: _handle_act() creates ResultPanelComponent for each tool result in trace_outputs
New results added to RenderState.current_turn_results with is_recent=True
When new user message detected (new STAR loop), current_turn_results move to historical_results with is_recent=False
Results render in chronological order: historical (collapsed) then recent (interactive)
Tests verify recent->historical transition on new user message
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add thread safety to RichCLIRenderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to handle concurrent broadcasts safely.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer uses threading.Lock around RenderState mutations
Broadcast messages queued if they arrive faster than render can process
No race conditions when multiple tools execute concurrently
Create tests/cli/test_thread_safety.py
Tests simulate rapid concurrent broadcasts and verify no data corruption
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add graceful degradation for limited terminals
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RichCLIRenderer to work in terminals without full rich support.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer detects terminal capabilities via rich.console.Console
If no color support, falls back to plain text output (--no-color mode)
If terminal too narrow (<80 cols), truncates tool card content gracefully
Handle terminal resize events without crashing
Tests verify degraded output in limited terminal simulation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integration test with DanaCodingAgent
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify RichCLIRenderer integrates seamlessly with DanaCodingAgent.
acceptanceCriteria: RichCLIRenderer attaches via agent.with_notifiable(RichCLIRenderer())
Works alongside existing ThoughtLogger without interference
No changes required to DanaCodingAgent code
Add usage example in RichCLIRenderer docstring
Create tests/cli/test_integration.py with full conversation simulation
Integration test mocks LLM and verifies complete STAR loop renders correctly
Typecheck passes
